caption:
Five Chilli Oil Rice Noodles & Vegetable Stir Fry
meal prep friendly | 30 minute recipe ( includes prep and cook time )
 
Ingredients: 
1 - 2 tbsp @boombayway Five Chilli Oil
1 onion, finely sliced 
200 grams mushroom, sliced
1 carrot, thinly sliced
1 capsicum, i use a mix of all red and yellow
120 grams rice noodles

Method: 
add the Chilli Oil to the pan and stir fry the vegetables 
add in the cooked rice noodles and some more Five Chilli Oil for flavour, combine and its ready!!!
sprinkle some fresh coriander to add a pop of freshness 

pro tip: add as much or as little as the Five Chilli Oil you need depending on your personal preference :)
